content.text:
[b]Your task:[/b]
1. Open [code]main.tscn[/code] (the 2D scene).
2. Add a [code]Label[/code] node named [code]StatusLabel[/code] as a child of Main.
3. Attach the script [code]player.gd[/code] to the Main node.
4. Complete [code]check_number()[/code] in player.gd so it returns "positive", "negative", or "zero".
5. Watch the live checks below turn green, then press [b]Run test cases[/b].

assessments.title: Check: conditions
assessments.question: A game gives the player a shield ONLY when health is below 20 AND the shield hasn't been used. How many conditions is the computer checking?

assessments.title: Decisions in real life
assessments.prompt: Describe one decision YOU made today as an if/else statement. What was the condition? What happened in each branch? Why did the condition have to be precise?
